responsibility: Implements the Rust dead-code liveness analysis that computes which HIR symbols are live. Starting from seed entry points such as the main function, it performs a worklist traversal over item bodies and selected expression forms, uses resolver and type-check data to map paths, method calls, field accesses, and type aliases back to referenced HIR items or impl items, and accumulates the live HirId set consumed by later dead-code warning passes.
same_name_distinction: Implements the mark-live analysis declared in the header: it finds entry points, runs the worklist, resolves referenced items and fields through resolver/type mappings, and populates the live symbol set, rather than just declaring the analysis class and visitor surface.
